title: Lamb Satay with Flatbread
description: A classic Thai dish featuring marinated lamb skewers served with crispy flatbread. A delicious and flavorful meal that's perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Shoulder or leg meat works best

ingredients.name: Vividly colored bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Any color bell peppers work well

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Add flavor to the lamb marinade

ingredients.name: Grated ginger
ingredients.notes: Add warmth and depth to the lamb

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together Syrian olive oil, fish sauce, brown sugar, grated ginger, garlic powder, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the lamb to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the lamb skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
6. Meanwhile, toast the flatbread by grilling for 1-2 minutes per side, or until crispy and slightly charred.
7. Serve the lamb skewers with toasted flatbread, sliced bell peppers, and your favorite dipping sauce.
